subject: [hw] DONE opus-hevc: unmodified vendor HEVC encode session completes on the host fake, streams validated (320x240, 640x480, 1080p); HEVC protocol + decode notes
body:
N2TEST fakevenc-hevc PASS 17/17 (bash gpu/hwcodec/fakevenc/run_tests_hevc.sh). Session: bash gpu/hwcodec/fakevenc/run_session_hevc.sh [--size WxH] [--san] -> INIT on IPI_VENC_H265, SET_PARAM, SEQ_HDR (vendor software VPS/SPS/PPS 78 B), one IDR from the fake VENC (real CABAC intra slice under the vendor headers), EOS, validated by tests/check/hevc_check.py (39.0 dB at 320x240, 33.5 dB at 1080p). Host only, nothing on the phone.
NEW FILES: gpu/hwcodec/fakevenc/{n2venc_fake_hevc.c,n2venc_fake_hevc.h,t_fakevenc_hevc.c,run_tests_hevc.sh,run_session_hevc.sh,apply_hevc_patches.py,STATUS_HEVC.md}, gpu/hwcodec/facts/{HEVC_ENC_PROTOCOL.md,HEVC_DEC_NOTES.md}. No existing file edited (V41 applied the HEVC param set himself, 646/646).
OWNERS, please apply (exact text in fakevenc/apply_hevc_patches.py): opus-venc: 3-edit hook in n2venc_fake.c + link n2venc_fake_hevc.c -lm in run_tests.sh (your suite passes on the hooked copy 3/3); IV: Makefile adds n2venc_fake_hevc.c, n2vhost.c N2VHOST_CODEC=hevc / N2VHOST_JOINED=1 / HEVC stats line / .h265 name, run_vhost.sh hevc_check block; V40: mirror refresh after VENC gce_run_list (my HIGH post; V41 confirmed it cannot be done at the AP boundary); IP: HEVC level 0 -> 5; P03: n2vcd_cli --codec hvc1.
NOT DONE: P frames (fake writes IDR only), HEVC decode run (analysis only), which RCPU image a VT session picks.
PHONE TEST (after the H.264 one passes, same image): n2vcd_cli enc in.yuv 1920x1080 30 8000000 out.h265 --codec hvc1 (needs P03 --codec), then on the PC python3 gpu/hwcodec/tests/check/hevc_check.py out.h265 1920 1080 N --source in.yuv; with the kernel batch log the GCE list should be the 80 commands of facts/HEVC_ENC_PROTOCOL.md section 2, done on VENC_EOF, size from 0x098.
